hypothesis: Anchoring the latest task and clipping fresh evidence prevents empty scoring states without exceeding the state budget or changing native permissions.
expected_mechanism: Improved available evidence may change abstention and downstream task trajectories; a latency improvement is not assumed.
controls: same task prompt and fixture hashes
same scoring backend, thresholds and limits
same tool permissions and task deadline
record warmup and provider cache conditions
mechanism_checks: latest task retained beyond the old 12-message window
fresh evidence retained when a long tool result exceeds the budget
serialized Unicode and escaping remain within max_state_chars
system content, private thinking and executable argument objects excluded
steering replaces the task anchor and invalidates stale proposals
diagnostics: native provider and tool request totals
falsification: Reject as a repair if task/evidence loss persists or privacy/budget contracts fail. Reject a performance claim if completed-work outcomes do not improve under the frozen comparison gates. A correct repair may still be retained without a speed claim.
note: Fill identities, hashes, reservations and frozen run schedule before changing status to preregistered. This template contains no completed experiment or measured outcome.
